correctness.rationale: One matching edge dominates at most six graph vertices: gamma_pr=2ceil(n/3), attained by every-third rungs. Column symbols 0,L,R,V encode each matching uniquely and ensure exact domination via length-three windows. Independently reconstructed 34 compatible pair states and 101 transitions, including cost potential yielding 44 zero, 24 unit, 29 double, 4 quadruple transitions. Zero-cost strongly connected components are only 3- and 6-cycles, hence D=(1-x^3)(1-x^6). Trace coefficients of defects 0,1,2 matched all displayed rational forms through n=103 using independent exact transfer/rational-recurrence computation. Since rational numerator after D^j clearing has respective degree <=33,67,101, coefficient agreement through 103 is exhaustive finite polynomial identity verification for all n, not mere extrapolation. A separate brute matching enumeration for n=3..8 corroborated Q_n and min counts. Formula counts matchings and not necessarily distinct vertex sets.
